entities.summary: Mecca, officially Makkah al-Mukarramah, is the holiest city in Islam. It is located in the Hejazi region of western Saudi Arabia and is the capital of Mecca Province. Mecca is considered the birthplace of Islam and is the birthplace of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
